reference: Olkiluoto, Finland, crystalline bedrock (no published log for these boxes), wet

description.lithology: Dark grey to black, fine- to medium-grained, foliated to gneissic mafic gneiss / amphibolitic veined gneiss (migmatitic biotite-hornblende gneiss) with abundant irregular white to pale-grey quartz-feldspar leucosome as patches, blebs and discontinuous veins up to a few cm wide; weak to moderate gneissic banding and foliation visible along the core length, leucosome locally discordant to foliation.

anomalies.explanation: Irregular white quartz-feldspar leucosome veins and patches occur throughout all rows as discontinuous bands, blebs and net-like segregations a few mm to a few cm wide that locally cut the foliation.
Discrete transverse fractures/breaks are visible in the core, most clearly in the top row and lower rows, with no visible fault gouge or infill resolvable in the photo.
